text:
Nina V: quick postmortem follow-up from the 02:14 UTC cascade \u2014 collecting owners and small-ticket PRs to reduce page noise.
Carlos R: saw a storm of identical pages caused by the same db-timeout error; dedupe grouped differently per region because the fingerprint included ephemeral request_id.
Ellen W: root cause summary in the doc: transient DB replicas lag + low alarm hysteresis + per-instance fingerprints. link: https://redwood.internal/pm/db-lag-02-14
Nina V: action suggestions (small, testable): 1) bump alarm hysteresis on db-replica-lag from 30s->90s and add a 4m cooldown. owner: Carlos R. ETA: 72h.
Nina V: 2) change dedupe fingerprint to use a stable signature (service+shard+error_class) and extend aggregation window to 240s. owner: Ellen W. ETA: 3 days.
Nina V: 3) create a "suppression shortlist" job that lists alerts firing >=7 times in 24h for manual review (no auto-suppress). owner: Maya T. ETA: 10 days.
Carlos R: ack. I'll open the alert PR and include a replay test against 2x baseline queries. will note expected false-positive risk.
Ellen W: ack. will implement fingerprinting change in routing and add a feature flag named dedupe_stable_sig. sample config below:
```yaml
dedupe:
  aggregation_seconds: 240
  signature_keys: [service, shard, error_class]
  feature_flag: dedupe_stable_sig
```
Maya T: ack. suppression shortlist will be a weekly cron that posts to #alerts-review and creates a ticket in the pm board. will include an opt-in auto-suppress flow gated by 2 reviewers.
AlertBot: Incident INC-33211 resolved. Please tag follow-up owners.
Carlos R: also adding a small safety measure: if suppression hits >20% of pages we emit a rollback alarm. owner: Carlos R. ETA: 1w.
Ellen W: can we add a short metric "aggregated_alert_rate" to the alerting dashboard so we can watch grouping changes after rollout? owner: Ellen W. ETA: 1w.
Maya T: putting all tasks into the postmortem board and scheduling a 15m check-in in 48h to verify PRs land and tests pass.
Nina V: optional: try a canary for the suppression shortlist where only non-prod alerts are auto-flagged for 48h before applying to prod. owner: Maya T. ETA: 2w.
Carlos R: PR opened: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/2567 (hysteresis + cooldown + rollback alarm).
Ellen W: branch: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-stable-sig-240s \u2014 unit tests added for cross-region grouping.
Maya T: shortlist job PR: https://git.redwood/ops/pull/78 \u2014 cron + board integration + reviewer gating.
Nina V: thanks everyone. closing thread once PRs merged and board card updated. leave a note in the oncall rotation if you need help. :white_check_mark:
